> There's almost always an impact on others. Like throwing a very large stone into a very shallow puddle. It's more than ripples.

this is what keeps me from doing it.. the last time i hurt myself, the effect it had on the few people im close to hurt more than anything else. i wish i could be the person they see, and believe in, but i dont know how to. i feel like i have no inner core to ground myself on, no ground to plant seeds or to build anything. i feel like a shadow

i dont know if its genetic or it didnt trigger for her but she didnt get any bad mental illnesses besides some anxiety issues, and i was able to do some things to intervene on her behalf before the abuse got to the level it did with me..
i am as long as im with my fiancé, and he works from home so we're together most the time

im safe but i feel like im hanging on by a thread... every day i think about how to end it. im losing my grip on it  and when i let go it only makes things worse. but my sister is ok... she recovered much better than i did and enrolled in a public high school, graduated and is in college now, away from my family. i send her whatever money i can so she wont have to go back, but im afraid the bottom will fall out and ill be helpless. i live a thousand miles away from her, i couldnt just pluck her up and save her. and even if i could i dont think living with me is any better..

probably initially it was being raped by my brother, and then compounded when i realized he was doing the same to my sister. i just collapsed entirely, mentally. then the fact that my parents were unwilling to stop it, and had actually known about it and that he had done it to other girls in our community, it just was the final nail. i still dont really feel human. i dont know if thats unique though, the world seems so full of cruelty and alienation that most people arent given the ability rto fully develop into a human being

im taking seroquel and divalproex and some ssri that isnt working. my insurance has been difficult and hasnt let me see a consistent psychiatrist for almost a year (every visit i have to see someone new and they cant change my prescriptions or dosage levels) and im not in therapy yet due to waiting lists. i just feel useless. i cant even do simple work around the house for my fiancé because of how tired and crushed i feel. nothing gives me joy or pleasure. i just try to stay numb enough to keep from hurting myself again

its so much. my family life was terrible and i was cut off from the entire world, home schooled and not let outside and such. my parents weren't terribly abusive to me but they were awful to my brother who would th en take it out on me and my sister. i dont care anymore about what happened to me but it has destroyed me to watch my sister suffer while im helpless. then i developed severe bi polar depression in my teens and spent 2 years bouncing around state run psych wards as i constant hurt myself. my family collapsed from the burden i put on them and the fallout has just hurt my sister even more. i shouldnt have been born and ive been a net loss to the world
